Q: Script to see if a list of users are in list of groups A:

Very similar to above (Thanks!) , Input a Security Group and Search AD for Users in the entered Security Group in other Security Groups using filtering (Hope this helps someone!) :

# ##########################################################################################################################
#                                                                                                                          #
# This script searches what Members are in what AD Groups by Group Naming                                                  #
# This script may take several minutes to run depending on the number of Users in the Group                                #
#                                                                                                                          #
# ##########################################################################################################################

Clear-Host

Write-Host
Write-Host -ForegroundColor Red "Script to Export the Users in a specific Groups in AD that are members of the other specified Security Group.
Write-Host -ForegroundColor Red "This script may take several minutes to run depending on the number of Users in the initial Group."
Write-Host

#$GrouptoCheck = "*Example_AD_Group*" # Entitlement Group for Pool
$GrouptoCheck = Read-Host "Enter the AD Group you want to query against App Volume Groups: "
Write-Host

$Result = @(); # Resets Array to Blank
#$UserstoCheck = Get-ADGroup -Filter {name -eq $GrouptoCheck} | Get-ADGroupMember
$UserstoCheck = Get-ADGroupMember $GrouptoCheck
$AppVolGroupstoCheck = Get-ADGroup -Filter "name -like 'AD_AppVolGroup_App_*'" # Can change filter for testing to reduce running time e.g. ..App_O*

Foreach ($Group in $AppVolGroupstoCheck) 
{
 $Members = (Get-ADGroupMember $Group).SamAccountName
 Foreach ($User in $UserstoCheck) 
  {
   IF ($Members -contains $User.SamAccountName) 
    { 
      $IsMember = $User.SamAccountName # Gets Friendly Username
      [array]$Result +=  "$IsMember, $($group.Name)" 
    }
  }
}

Write-Host
Write-Output $Result # Console Output

$Result | Out-File "C:\Temp\AppVol_$EntitlementGrouptoCheck.txt"  # Export into Excel with Pivot
